name: brief
title: Brief
about: Eos, the morning brief: one short read for the day (weather, calendar, people, money, what's due), made before his first unlock.

routines.name: Morning brief
routines.action: Write today's brief in the brief app (a briefs row for today: md + cards). Post its card at his first unlock after 5 AM (the first unlock fact after 05:00).
